## Authority concerning a private research archive

**Principal:** ⟦PERSON|苏砚⟧

**Attorney:** ⟦PERSON|Anouk D'Evrin⟧

**Custodian:** ⟦ORG|Pebble Loom Archives Ltd⟧ (the Custodian)

The principal authorises the attorney to inspect the deposited notebooks and obtain one digital copy of the catalogue. The notebooks remain the principal's property. This instrument gives no authority to publish their contents, license an illustration or consent to destruction of an original page.

Before inspection, the attorney must confirm the inventory against the sealed deposit receipt. Any discrepancy must be reported in writing. The custodian may supervise handling and require the use of supports for fragile bindings, provided that those requirements do not prevent a reasonable inspection.

The principal's name appears in its original script throughout the deposit records. The catalogue confirmation must therefore be addressed to ⟦PERSON|苏砚⟧ rather than to an invented transliteration. Correspondence may be sent to ⟦EMAIL|archive.instructions@pebble-loom.invalid⟧.

The copying budget is EUR 240. No continuing subscription or additional deposit may be purchased under this authority. Expenses above that amount require a separate instruction signed by the principal.

Executed on 10 November 2026. The authority ends when the catalogue copy has been delivered and checked, or after sixty days, whichever occurs first.

Principal's signature: ⟦PERSON|苏砚⟧.

Attorney's acceptance: ⟦PERSON|Anouk D'Evrin⟧.
